drums.tags: Tech House. A syncopated, percussive bassline with a short decay and resonant filter envelope drives the groove. The drum arrangement features a crisp 909-style open hi-hat on the off-beats, a tight closed hi-hat playing sixteenth notes, and a dry, punchy snare on beats 2 and 4. A recurring two-note staccato synth stab with a metallic timbre and short delay repeats every two bars. A low-pass filtered vocal sample is used as a rhythmic texture, repeating a short phrase. The track features subtle white noise risers and downlifters to mark phrase transitions. 126 BPM, G minor, 4/4 time.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[four-on-the-floor kick drum, shaker]
[syncopated sub-bass enters]

[Main Groove]
[909-style open hi-hat on off-beats]
[staccato metallic synth stab repeats every two bars]
[low-pass filtered rhythmic vocal chop]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out]
[white noise riser builds]
[filtered synth lead swells]

[Drop]
[kick and bass return]
[snare on beats 2 and 4]
[sixteenth-note closed hi-hats]
